name: vehicles
code: Vehicle c = new Car("ZH 1"), m = new Motorbike("ZH 2"), t = new Truck("BE 3"); return c.units() + " " + m.units() + " " + t.units() + " | " + c.fee(2) + " " + c.fee(10) + " " + m.fee(1) + " " + m.fee(3) + " " + t.fee(2) + " | " + c.getPlate();

name: park
code: Garage g = new Garage(6); boolean a = g.park(new Car("ZH 1")); boolean b = g.park(new Truck("BE 2")); boolean c = g.park(new Car("ZH 1")); boolean d = g.park(new Motorbike("AG 3")); return a + " " + b + " " + c + " " + d + " " + g.freeUnits();

name: leave
code: Garage g = new Garage(6); g.park(new Car("ZH 1")); g.park(new Motorbike("AG 3")); int f1 = g.leave("ZH 1", 10); int free = g.freeUnits(); boolean t = g.park(new Truck("BE 2")); int f2 = g.leave("AG 3", 2); return f1 + " " + free + " " + t + " " + f2 + " " + g.revenue() + " " + g.freeUnits();

name: no-instanceof
message: Let each vehicle class decide its units and fee (polymorphism) instead of checking instanceof in Garage.
messageDe: Lass jede Fahrzeugklasse ihre Einheiten und Gebühr selbst bestimmen (Polymorphie), statt in Garage mit instanceof zu prüfen.
